notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary object-management surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies object registration and discovery, ordinary and multiple object-name reservation, named registration, identity lookups, attribute-value update requests and responses, local deletion, remote deletion, and pre-connect/pre-join negative boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object registration, name reservation, value-request, and deletion services with FederateAmbassador object callbacks
